sys_script_include.description:
This script include is called by 24 schedule items in sys_trigger table. Objective : This script include has multiple functions for creation and updation of Records from staging table(MSS Event Inbound) to various tables like HSBC Trade, Business Process Instance, Trade case table.
Functions: • mssEventQueue -This function is called by all 24 schedule items. The value from Queue Field in MSS Event Inbound table is passed as the parameter. -This function calls another function 'validateBusinessProcessInstanceAndHSBCEventForJob' which has multiple functions for creation and updation of Records and also returns the Processing status value.
• checkIDandVersion -This function checks the ObjectId and Object Version in HSBCTrade table and performs action based on below criteria, -If Object ID is already present and Object Version is new then updation of the Record happens. -If Object ID and Object Version are already present, then no insertion or updation happens. -If Object ID and Object Version are not present, then insertion of new Record happens.
• getHsbcTradeRecord -This function checks whether the Object ID is present in HSBC Trade table and returns it.
• insertHsbcRecFromMssEvent -This function is for Insertion of Record from MSS Event Inbound table to HSBC Trade table.
• updateHsbcRecFromMssEvent -This function is for Updation of Record from MSS Event Inbound table to HSBC Trade table.
• mssEventToHsbcTrade -This function calls the functions "insertHsbcRecFromMssEvent" and "updateHsbcRecFromMssEvent" based on conditions.
• createHsbcBusinessProcessInstanceRec -This function is for Insertion of Record from MSS Event Inbound table to Business Process Instance table.
• updateHsbcBusinessProcessInstanceRec -This function is for Updation of Record from MSS Event Inbound table to Business Process Instance table.
• getBusinessProcessInstance -This function queries for ObjectID in Business Process Instance table.
• getBusinessProcessStageStatus -This function queries for Status in Business Process stages table.
• validateBusinessProcessInstanceAndHSBCEventForJob -This function has multiple functions for creation and updation of Records from staging table(MSS Event Inbound) to various tables like HSBC Trade, Business Process Instance, Trade case table and also returns the Processing status value.
sys_script_include.name: HSBCMSSEventUtils
